'''Version 1.9.9''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on January 3rd 2023.  It was 15.54 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Configuration</u>====
*Added category for [[Incomplete Forms|Incomplete Form (Small)]]
*Added category for [[Incomplete Forms|Incomplete Form (Medium)]]
*"Value for Despawning" updated description "Number of Points gained when Adapted versions spawned from moving flesh despawn, set this value to 0 in you dont want adapted to despawn."
*"[[Parasitic Cyst|Cyst]] Enabled" updated description "Set to true if you want parasites to store blocks in their inventory and then place them in a cyst."
*New options:
**"[[Living Armor]] Point Cap" - "Cap of points used to reduce damage taken." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Living Armor Damage Type Cap" - "How many damage types the version can learn and adapt." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Living Armor Point Reduction Value" - "Value for each point, used to reduce damage taken." - SRParasites.cfg
**"[[Sentient Armor]] Point Cap" - "Cap of points used to reduce damage taken." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Sentient Armor Damage Type Cap" - "How many damage types the version can learn and adapt." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Sentient Armor Point Reduction Value" - "Value for each point, used to reduce damage taken." - SRParasites.cfg
**"[[Needler]] Immune Mob List" - "Mobs that are immune to the Needler effect, Ex: \"minecraft:zombie\" or just \"minecraft\" for a whole mod" - SRParasitesSystems.cfg
**"Needler Immune Mob List Inverted" - "Set to true if you want to use the list as a WhiteList." - SRParasitesSystems.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated]] Sneak Penalty" - "Penalty for parasites when someone is sneaking, the lower the value the higher the chance of not being seen, vanilla value is 0.800000011920929." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version Assimilated Invisible Penalty" - "Penalty for parasites when someone is invisible, the lower the value the higher the chance of not being seen, vanilla value is 0.7." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] Sneak Penalty" - "Penalty for parasites when someone is sneaking, the lower the value the higher the chance of not being seen, vanilla value is 0.800000011920929." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version Primitive Invisible Penalty" - "Penalty for parasites when someone is invisible, the lower the value the higher the chance of not being seen, vanilla value is 0.7." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Sneak Penalty" - "Penalty for parasites when someone is sneaking, the lower the value the higher the chance of not being seen, vanilla value is 0.800000011920929." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version Adapted Invisible Penalty" - "Penalty for parasites when someone is invisible, the lower the value the higher the chance of not being seen, vanilla value is 0.7." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure]] Sneak Penalty" - "Penalty for parasites when someone is sneaking, the lower the value the higher the chance of not being seen, vanilla value is 0.800000011920929." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version Pure Invisible Penalty" - "Penalty for parasites when someone is invisible, the lower the value the higher the chance of not being seen, vanilla value is 0.7." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]] Sneak Penalty" - "Penalty for parasites when someone is sneaking, the lower the value the higher the chance of not being seen, vanilla value is 0.800000011920929." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Version Preeminent Invisible Penalty" - "Penalty for parasites when someone is invisible, the lower the value the higher the chance of not being seen, vanilla value is 0.7." - SRParasites.cfg
**"Target Blocks" - "Set to false if you dont want parasites to target light/circuit blocks." - SRParasites.cfg
 
====<u>General changes</u>====
*[[Living Armor|Living]]/[[Sentient Armor|Sentient armor]] can now [[Adaptation System|adapt]] to damage: (WIP)
**Damage taken while burning will be multiplied by "Mob Fire Damage Multiplier" config value
**If Damage Type is fire, damage will be multiplied by "Mob Fire Damage Multiplier" config value
**Will give [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]] to the attacker if available
**Is immune to the [[Corrosion|corrosive]] effect
**Enchantability for armor/weapons set to 1
 
====<u>Mobs</u>====
*Removed [[Assimilated Enderman|Enderman]] Leap (crawling variant)
*[[Dispatcher (Disambiguation)|Dispatcher]] AI changes:
**It can target multiple mobs at the same time - all stages
**Can "store" parasites to later spawn them (this mobs saves their entityid) - all stages
**If a [[Buglin|buglin]] is stored then it will spawn as a [[Rupter]] - from [[Stage II Dispatcher|stage II]]
**If a rupter is stored then it will spawn as a [[Mangler]] - from [[Stage III Dispatcher|stage III]]
**If enough assimilated are stored then it will spawn them as a primitive - from [[Stage III Dispatcher|stage III]]
**If enought incomplete forms are stored then it will spawn them as a [[:Category:Crude Parasites|crude]] version - points required: 6
***[[Incomplete Forms|Small incomplete]] value: 1
***[[Incomplete Forms|Medium incomplete]] value: 2
***[[Heed]] - from stage II beckon
***[[Crux]] - from stage III beckon
